Home About Us PRODUCTS ▾ Pedals Amps Merch Merch Dealers-Artists ▾ Dealers Artists Contact Us ▾ CONTACT WARRANTY REPAIRS POLICIES Cart Home / Products / Peacemaker Peacemaker $229.00 Qty Add to Cart We posted this on Instagram. Now folks want it…back for a bit. Not sure how long. Not sure how many. This is gonna be fun, and I like fun. What happens when you run one old school transistor based gain stage into another one, and use them as a drive-meets-distortion!? Well...you get the Peacemaker. We've built this pedal for about 20 years or so now, doing small batch runs here and there. These are fun pedals that can do a slight "vintage feeling and sounding" eq shift with boost capabilities, or they can push into drive meets distortion territory. The sound is very much a transistor drive-distortion sound, and has a very unique and fun character to it. Slam a tube amp with this pedal, and it's a dream. This pedal requires a 9 volt battery or 9 volt DC power supply, in the standard negative center pin configuration. It's simple, it sounds great, and it's a lot of fun. There's no way to fluff this up, so I won't try to do so. If you want something that will make you smile with a Strat, Tele, or a Les Paul...you found it...personally, I like having fun...do you?
